[[Captain Greywind]] asks you to provide blankets for the Ascalon Settlers.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Go to [[Nebo Village]] with the [[Militia Weapon]]s. Talk to [[Etham the Artisan]] and trade the weapons for [[Settlement Blanket|blankets]].
*Take the blankets to Captain Greywind.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Longbow (Blankets for the Settlers)|Longbow]]
: [[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]] 13-25 (Requires 6 [[Marksmanship]])
: Damage +10% (while in a [[Stance]])
: Received [[physical damage]] -2 (while in a Stance)
: Two-handed Hornbow

==Walkthrough==
Captain Greywind will give you a [[Militia Weapon]] chest. Take it west with you to [[Nebo Village]]. You will encounter some [[tengu]] just after entering [[Nebo Terrace]], and you may pass some [[ettin]]s in the fields, but most if not all of the enemies should be easy to avoid.

Talk to [[Etham the Artisan]] in Nebo Village and trade the weapons for [[Settlement Blanket|blankets]]. Then simply return the way you came and give the blankets to Captain Greywind to complete the quest.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Captain Greywind
:''"I have arranged to open trade with Nebo Village to the west. They are renowned for their weaving, and my people here are short on many cloth goods, such as blankets. Their village has, of late, been subject to numerous predacations by bandits and while we cannot spare guards, our passage across the mountains was costly enough that we do have weapons to spare.''

:''Can you take this stash of weapons and trade them to '''Ethan the Artisan''' in '''Nebo Village'''."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Glad to be of service.
| decline = I'm busy right now
| ask = I've given you what you need.  Please follow the road to '''Nebo Village''' and look for '''Etham the Artisan'''.  He will provide you with the blankets we need
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Etham the Artisan
:''"Ah, yes.  I have been expecting you.  I hope this is the beginning of much fruitful trade between the Ascalon Settlement and our village."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Captain Greywind
:''"These blankets will be put to good use.  Thank you for securing them."''

==Notes==
* This quest pairs well with [[The Weaver of Nebo]], since both require talking to Etham the Artisan.
* If it is your first time visiting Nebo Terrace, consider unlocking [[Beetletun]] or [[Bergen Hot Springs]] while there for easier return trips.
